blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Abbotsford West. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Abbotsford West, Abbotsford: 138 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 12 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 9 Abbotsford communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Abbotsford West fell from 141 in June to 138 in September (−2.1%), and 55 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 31.4% of Abbotsford’s 440 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Abbotsford West?
Abbotsford West also had 210 condos and townhomes listed and 16 sold in September, against 138 houses listed. The Abbotsford West condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Abbotsford West home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

118 houses sold in Abbotsford West with a median price of $1,023,564 (the middle half sold between $927,075 and $1,137,500), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 95.9% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $403 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 6,960 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Abbotsford West?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 138 houses listed in Abbotsford West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Abbotsford West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Abbotsford West had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Abbotsford West from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 55 houses sold in Abbotsford West over those 4 months, out of 215 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Abbotsford West?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Abbotsford West sell for?
faq.a: 118 houses sold in Abbotsford West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,023,564.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Abbotsford West?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.9% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
